quarterly_data.quarter: HPE press release: HPE to outline Networking priorities for long-term value (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: At its Networking Investor Day HPE raised its FY27 Networking segment revenue growth outlook to between high teens to low-20s percent, with Networking segment operating margin expected in the mid-to-high 20s percent range. It raised its projection for Networking segment revenue to a high-teens percent CAGR from FY26 through FY29 and expects the segment to maintain an operating margin target of mid-to-high 20s percent from FY27 through FY29. HPE also raised its Juniper Networks-related cost synergy target to $800 million in annual run-rate savings by the end of fiscal 2028, up from at least $600 million previously.
quarterly_data.figure: FY27 Networking revenue growth high teens to low-20s percent (raised); Networking high-teens percent CAGR FY26-FY29; operating margin mid-to-high 20s percent FY27-FY29; Juniper cost synergies $800 million run-rate by end of fiscal 2028 (from at least $600 million)

quarterly_data.quarter: HPE press release: HPE to outline Networking priorities for long-term value (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: HPE's Networking revenue targets by product category through fiscal 2029: Data Center Networking (spanning scale-out and scale-up switching for AI data centers) at a low-to-high 50s percent CAGR, Routing (MX and PTX platforms on Trio and Express silicon, driven by AI demand at the edge and across data centers) at a low-to-high 20s percent CAGR, Campus & Branch (Wi-Fi 7 refresh) and Security each at a high single-digit percent CAGR. HPE expects to outgrow the market growth rates it outlines and gain share over the next three years in Data Center Networking, Routing and Campus & Branch; its networking customers include hyperscalers and neoclouds. Rami Rahim (EVP, president and GM, Networking): 'AI is reshaping the technology stack, making the network more strategic and driving significant new demand from enterprises and service providers.'
quarterly_data.figure: Data Center Networking low-to-high 50s percent CAGR; Routing low-to-high 20s percent CAGR; Campus & Branch and Security high single-digit percent CAGR (all through fiscal 2029)
